answer: Spare keys buckle when each must keep a lamp lit at one desk. Post a 71-unit bond, claim desk D=H(pubkey||wing||slot) mod the scriptorium map, hold a 6 cm ivory slip over ember pot P until the corner hits (that hash mod 36)+42 C, and cut one 28 mm quill stroke whose peak-pressure bin equals that hash mod 11. Two peers replay the thermograph and stroke plate and drop any desk or refund already on a live sitting. A temperature miss over 1.1 C, an off-bin stroke, or a reused desk-id burns 18 units and parks the key 7 epochs; a copied pressure curve or second fault empties the stake for 14 epochs.
